label: Malted milk
note: Invented as an infant food: James Horlick, a London pharmacist, formed J & W Horlicks in 1873, patent 1883 for a formula with dried milk; the name malted milk was trademarked 1887.

about.text: A powder of malted barley, wheat flour and dried whole milk, stirred into hot or cold milk or water. It began as an infant food and became a drink and a flavour of sweets.
